notes.content:
[h2]Refined game rules[/h2]
We've revised the rules, corrected typos, and ensured greater consistency throughout.

[h2]Minor bug fix[/h2]

Dive into these new games and let the fun begin!

We hope you love this update as much as we loved creating it for you.

If you’re enjoying this update, we’d greatly appreciate it if you could leave a positive review to support us and motivate us to make it even better. If there's something you didn't like or a game you're missing, please reach out to us on the discussion forum, and we'll do our best to address it.

[b]Happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: New Games & Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Enhancements in Settings Dialog[/h2]
We've polished the settings dialog for a more user-friendly experience. Additionally, we've introduced a new hide/show option for the pile count, giving you greater control over your gaming setup.

[h2]Refined Game Rules[/h2]
We've clarified and refined the rules for [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/simplicity]Simplicity[/url] and [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/autumn-leaves]Autumn Leaves[/url]

[h2]Minor bug fix[/h2]
We've squashed a stock bug where moves were incorrectly counted, even when stock cards couldn't be played.

[h2]Exciting New Game Additions[/h2]
Get ready to explore and conquer new, unusual games/puzzles. The following have been added to your collection.

[b]Solitaire variants:[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/accordion]Accordion[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/bridesmaids]Bridesmaids[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/british-constitution]British Constitution[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/capuchin]Capuchin[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/interregnum]Interregnum[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/roaming-proils]Roaming Proils[/url]
[/list]
[b]And introducing puzzle enthusiasts to:[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/lights-out-4x4]Lights Out[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/sliding-puzzle-3x3]Sliding Puzzle[/url]
[/list]
[b]Sharpen your memory skills with:[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/concentration]Concentration[/url]
[/list]
[b]Strategize and conquer with:[/b]
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.esolutions.se/Solitaire/empire]Empire[/url]
[/list]

Dive into these new games and let the fun begin!

We hope you enjoy this update as much as we enjoyed bringing it to you. Stay tuned for more exciting features in future releases.

Happy gaming!
